notes_for_editor: Only two sources were read. The Canada Lookouts page's text gives a name and nothing else, so no build date, design, staffing or fate can be cited. A map may be embedded on that page but was not visible in the text read, so the story does not mention one. The blog's Blue Hill Lookout is a viewpoint in Terra Nova National Park; the same blog also mentions a 'Blue Hill Pond' on the Goowiddy Path in the park, but nothing read says that is the site of the Bluehill Pond index entry, so the story does not treat them as the same place and a human should check. The index coordinates in the record (48.6054, -53.9425) were not confirmed by any text. A search hit for a 'Blue Hill fire tower' removed in 2005 is a Facebook group post that appears to concern Sundre, Alberta (the group is named 'Sundre Back in Time'), so it was not used. The Canada Lookouts Alberta index also lists a 'Blue Hill', so the name collides. A search for Newfoundland tower history turned up NRCan's 'Newfoundland Forest Fire History, 1916-1960' record, but its PDF was not read. A human should check Parks Canada and Newfoundland and Labrador forestry sources before any date or design is added.
